physical_roles.T1: TLS client and primary session ledger
physical_roles.T2: middlebox client or opaque TCP relay; primary inter-middlebox observer
physical_roles.T3: middlebox server or opaque TCP relay; corroborating raw capture
physical_roles.T4: HIGGS endpoint and separate TLS evidence replica on port 8000

observer.bpf: host 172.31.34.237 and host 172.31.38.41 and (tcp or udp)
common_fields: IPv4 total packet length including transport headers and ACKs
observer.management_traffic: T1-to-T4 backup traffic excluded from declared inter-middlebox observer; no global-observer claim
observer.wire_gate: Record MTU/NIC offloads; reject unexplained superpackets, fragments, truncation, drops or incomplete coverage

topologies.greenshaping: T1 verified end-to-end TLS -> T2 opaque TCP relay -> T3 opaque TCP relay -> T4 tool endpoint
topologies.netshaper: T1 verified end-to-end TLS -> T2 upstream peer1 -> QUIC/UDP -> T3 upstream peer2 -> T4 tool endpoint

runtime.basis: 84-session cloud correctness check: GreenShaping 60 sessions=231.34s; upstream no-shaping/shaping 12 sessions=16.39s/20.47s, plus deployment/capture/backup margin

durability.resume: Audit committed sessions; interrupted acquisition never auto-replayed or appended as a new independent repetition
durability.raw_capture: Preserve both T2 and T3 pcaps plus capture loss/stop logs; no ring overwrite
durability.archives: Verified copy to Mac Studio plus controller; no removal before restore verification

scientific_limits: TRAIN calibration only, insufficient for confirmatory attacker accuracy
NetShaper noiseMultiplier does not establish matched epsilon/adjacency
One shared multiplexed observer link cannot be relabeled as 20 observable site links
No calibrated physical energy measurements on EC2
Full answer-agent utility and final-test acquisition remain separate gates
gates_pending: Per-phase resource/clock and capture validity gates
